findings.title: settings.local.json silently overrides deny rules in settings.json
findings.details: settings.json:59-60 denies 'Bash(git push origin main*)' and 'Bash(git push origin develop*)'. settings.local.json:7 explicitly allows 'Bash(git push origin main)' and lines 8-11 allow '--force-with-lease' variants to main and sprint branches. Line 38 allows 'Bash(git push:*)' which matches any push target including protected branches. Line 37 'Bash(git reset:*)' also supersedes the narrower deny on 'git reset --hard*'. This nullifies the CI/branch protection intent of settings.json.
findings.remediation: Delete lines 7, 8-11, 37, 38 from settings.local.json. If force-push to a feature branch is genuinely needed, scope it: 'Bash(git push origin sprint1/* --force-with-lease)'.

findings.title: Pre-commit hook is not installed in .git/hooks/
findings.details: Only pre-commit.sample exists in .git/hooks/. The script at .claude/hooks/pre-commit (secrets, forbidden files, PII, branch, money gates) is dormant. Every safety gate documented in CLAUDE.md and .agents/workflows/pre-commit.md is bypassed for local commits.
findings.remediation: Run 'cp .claude/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit' or add a SessionStart hook that installs it automatically.

findings.title: Broad interpreter and shell patterns in settings.local.json
findings.details: 'Bash(python3 -c :*)' (unmatched quote), 'Bash(python:*)', 'Bash(python3 *)', 'Bash(py *)', 'Bash(curl *)' all grant arbitrary code execution or arbitrary network egress. A hijacked prompt could exfiltrate secrets via curl or run destructive Python one-liners.
findings.remediation: Replace with explicit commands: 'Bash(python3 -m pytest*)', 'Bash(python3 -m py_compile*)', 'Bash(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w * https://spinr-backend-production.up.railway.app/health)'. Remove the wildcard python/curl entries entirely.

findings.title: Attribution trailer pinned to stale model name (claude-sonnet-4-6)
findings.details: settings.json pins model to 'claude-opus-4-7' (line 2) but attribution.commit references 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Git history confirms 28 commits carry sonnet-4-6 attribution vs 19 with opus-4-7 — commits are being trailered with the wrong model name.
findings.remediation: Edit settings.json:7 to 'Co-developed with Claude Code (claude-opus-4-7)\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>'.

findings.title: Windows-machine paths embedded in settings.local.json
findings.details: Paths '/c/Users/TabUsrDskOff111/spinr/spinr/backend/requirements.txt' and '//c/Users/swarn/.claude/plugins/cache/*' reference developer machines that are not this Linux container. On Linux these never match. On the original Windows host they may have unintended scope. 'Bash(powershell.exe -Command ipconfig)' (line 57) is Windows-only. These are drift artefacts from previous developers.
findings.remediation: Delete lines 18-30, 45-46, 57 from settings.local.json. Replace pip-audit/trufflehog entries with cross-platform forms: 'Bash(pip-audit -r backend/requirements.txt)', 'Bash(trufflehog git file://.*)'.

findings.title: launch.json has rider-app / driver-app swapped
findings.details: 'Rider App (Metro)' (line 11) launches 'frontend' on 8081. 'Driver App (Metro)' (line 17) launches 'rider-app' on 8082. Per CLAUDE.md surfaces table, rider-app/ is the rider and driver-app/ is the driver. No Metro config here launches driver-app/.
findings.remediation: Rider App → --prefix rider-app. Driver App → --prefix driver-app. Remove the legacy 'frontend/' entry or rename to 'Frontend (legacy)'.

findings.title: andrej-karpathy-skills plugin is unpinned
findings.details: 'andrej-karpathy-skills@karpathy-skills': true has no version pin. marketplace.json declares version 1.0.0 but the repo at forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills receives commits (last observed 2026-04-20). Auto-updates change prompts that Claude Code receives at session start.
findings.remediation: Pin to an explicit commit SHA or tag via the marketplace manifest, or mirror the plugin into the repo and reference locally.

findings.title: No SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / PreCompact hooks
findings.details: Only the user-scope ~/.claude/settings.json defines a Stop hook (stop-hook-git-check.sh). Project scope defines zero. A SessionStart hook would pre-warm deps for each surface (satisfies Phase 2.13). A PreToolUse hook on Write could re-verify the float-money rule.
findings.remediation: Add SessionStart to install .git/hooks/pre-commit and run 'yarn install' in rider-app/driver-app/admin-dashboard on first tool call.

findings.title: Contradictions across CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, .agents/docs/architecture.md
findings.details: Python version: CLAUDE.md + ARCHITECTURE.md say 3.12; .agents/docs/architecture.md:41 says '3.11+'. Token expiry: CLAUDE.md says 15 min access / 30 day refresh; .agents/docs/architecture.md:22 says 'Token expiry: 30 days (consider reducing)'. Surface count: CLAUDE.md lists 5 (adds 'shared/'); .agents/docs/architecture.md lists 4. db.py coexistence is listed as debt in the nested doc but CLAUDE.md only names db_supabase.py.
findings.remediation: Mark .agents/docs/architecture.md as superseded by CLAUDE.md + ARCHITECTURE.md, or update to match. Add a 'last reconciled' footer.

findings.title: Secret regex missing GitHub fine-grained token prefixes
findings.details: Only 'ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}' is detected. Modern GitHub tokens include gho_ (OAuth), ghu_ (user-to-server), ghs_ (server-to-server), ghr_ (refresh). A compromised OAuth or App token would slip past.
findings.remediation: Change to 'gh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}' and also add Anthropic admin keys 'sk-ant-admin-*', Slack webhooks 'T[A-Z0-9]{8}/B[A-Z0-9]{8}/', and AWS access keys 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'.

findings.title: PII-in-logs regex only checks ADDED lines
findings.details: 'git diff --cached --diff-filter=A' restricts to newly added files. A change that appends a console.log(lat) to an existing file passes the gate.
findings.remediation: Drop --diff-filter=A from all gates. Scan any added line regardless of file novelty.

findings.title: Write(frontend/**) allows writes to a legacy surface
findings.details: CLAUDE.md lists 5 surfaces and does not include frontend/. CI comment in .github/workflows/ci.yml:175 confirms 'frontend/ is the legacy combined app'. Granting Claude write access encourages edits to dead code.
findings.remediation: Remove 'Write(frontend/**)' from settings.json allow list. If legacy access is needed temporarily, move to settings.local.json with a TODO for removal.

findings.title: 256 of 310 historical commits have no Claude attribution trailer
findings.details: Only 54 of 310 commits bear 'Co-Authored-By: Claude'. 28 of those reference sonnet-4-6, 19 reference opus-4-7, 7 reference neither. This is drift from both the current pinned model and the old sonnet-4-6 string.
findings.remediation: Not retroactively fixable. Ensure the /commit slash command and Claude harness both emit the corrected opus-4-7 trailer going forward.

findings.title: memory/ and discovery/ are stale scaffolding
findings.details: memory/ contains only .gitkeep. discovery/ is a sandbox with package.json + _layout.tsx but no references from CLAUDE.md, the rider app, or admin.
findings.remediation: Archive both under docs/archive/ or delete. Document purpose if either is active.

findings.title: .kilo/, .emergent/, .maestro/, audit-framework/ are undocumented in CLAUDE.md
findings.details: .maestro/ is Mobile E2E test definitions. .emergent/ has summary.txt + markers/. .kilo/ holds plans. audit-framework/ looks recent (April 22). None of these are mentioned in CLAUDE.md so Claude receives no guidance on whether to touch them.
findings.remediation: Add a 'Claude-adjacent directories' subsection to CLAUDE.md. Default each to read-only in permissions.

findings.title: 8 duplicate code_review_report_2026*.json files in repo root
findings.details: code_review_report_20260326_{163444,163509,181043,181149,181200,181313,181419}.json are byte-identical 72,187 byte duplicates. Unclear why they are committed.
findings.remediation: Move to docs/audit/ archive or delete. Add 'code_review_report_*.json' to .gitignore.

findings.title: No surface has a SessionStart hook to pre-warm deps
findings.details: Claude Code on the web cannot run 'pytest', 'yarn test', 'npm test' without manual install. No surface has scaffolded a SessionStart hook.
findings.remediation: Invoke /session-start-hook skill to scaffold one that runs pip install, yarn install, npm ci in each surface.

findings.title: Graphify graph is 3 days behind most recent commits
findings.details: Graph last generated 2026-04-19. Commits 9ccf22b, 019f589, 1f8dcab on 2026-04-22 have not been incorporated. CLAUDE.md directs Claude to rebuild after modifying code, but since this audit is read-only no rebuild is warranted.
findings.remediation: Defer to next code-editing session. Rebuild command in CLAUDE.md:12.

findings.title: sprint1/* force-push allow rules are outdated
findings.details: --force-with-lease allows for sprint1/backend-security, sprint1/admin-hardening, sprint1/cicd-hardening. No sprint1/* branch currently exists locally or in the output of 'git branch -a'.
findings.remediation: Delete lines 9-11.

findings.title: Graphify god nodes partially unreferenced in CLAUDE.md
findings.details: Top 10 god nodes from graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md:427: get_rows (230 edges), request, update_one, Error, AgentTask, BaseAgent, run_sync, KnowledgeEntry, RideStateError, TaskStatus. CLAUDE.md mentions run_sync (line 91) and the ride state machine (maps to RideStateError) but does not mention AgentTask/BaseAgent/KnowledgeEntry — these live in agents/ which CLAUDE.md never describes.
findings.remediation: Add a short 'agents/ package (Python)' subsection to CLAUDE.md pointing to agents/base_agent.py and agents/orchestrator.py.

findings.title: Pre-commit hook has no unit tests
findings.details: No file in tests/ or elsewhere exercises the regex patterns. Regression against a gate cannot be caught.
findings.remediation: Add tests/hooks/test_pre_commit.sh that stages synthetic diffs (fake sk_live, fake .env, console.log(lat)) and asserts exit code 1.
